native_office_render: Editable PowerPoint exported successfully to a 20-page PDF in LibreOffice; business-model preview visually reviewed. Microsoft PowerPoint itself was not run.
workbook_recalculation: LibreOffice recalculated six valid cohort cases and four guard/quote cases. Cached formulas compared against independent Python and browser models. Nine sheets, three charts and input validations retained.
financial_boundary: School counts, mix, cost/retention/collection assumptions and budget are scenarios. Contribution is not actual profit. School tuition and provider-funded services are excluded from platform subscriptions.
public_configuration_boundary: Reference prices and offers are editable configuration, not independently fetched binding live quotes.
